color.$description: Semantic color contract. Every token documents its fallback value here; see section 4 of docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

border.$description: Decorative separators only; not load-bearing for meaning.

border-strong.$description: Input borders and control outlines. 3.52:1 vs surface.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text and helper copy. 6.64:1 vs surface.

primary-text.$description: Primary-colored TEXT on the surface — ghost button labels, links. Light: identical to `primary` (7.10:1 vs surface). The token exists so the dark theme can diverge, where primary-as-surface is not text-usable.

primary-fg.$description: Text and icon color on top of --sk-color-primary.

danger-fg.$description: Danger text and icons on light surfaces.

success-fg.$description: Success text and icons on light surfaces.

warning-fg.$description: Warning text and icons on light surfaces.

success-subtle.$description: Tinted fill for badges and soft state chips. Success foreground on it is 6.41:1.

warning-subtle.$description: Tinted fill for badges and soft state chips. Warning foreground on it is 6.44:1.

danger-subtle.$description: Tinted fill for badges and soft state chips. Danger foreground on it is 5.70:1.

primary-subtle.$description: Tinted fill for badges and soft state chips. Pair it with --sk-color-primary, not --sk-color-primary-fg: primary on this fill is 6.10:1, while white is 1.16:1. The primary badge variant uses a solid fill instead, so it needs no such pairing.

accent-coral.$description: Decoration and data-viz accent. Never the sole carrier of state.

accent-mint.$description: Decoration and data-viz accent. Never the sole carrier of state.

focus-ring.$description: Focus indicator. 7.10:1 vs surface; 3:1 against adjacent colors.

shadow.$description: Hard offset shadow color for brutalist chrome. 16.34:1 vs surface; gated at 3:1, the same standard as color.focus-ring, because a shadow is not text.

glass.$description: Glass overlay roles. The only alpha values in the system; `blur` and `saturate` are theme-independent and declared in dimensions.tokens.json, every color here is per theme.

bg-strong.$description: Panels that sit over busy content and still need to carry text.

highlight.$description: Top-edge specular line; what reads as iOS rather than a translucent box.

fallback.$description: Solid surface used when `backdrop-filter` is unsupported. Near-opaque so text stays legible; it is a theme color because a fallback panel still has to match the theme it renders in.
